summary_50: Enterprise search systems often suffer from high token usage, slow retrieval latencies, and complex external vector database dependencies (e.g. Pinecone) that complicate deployment pipelines.
summary_100: Astra Knowledge Graph Engine in Git-controlled static JSON + in-memory MiniSearch: Enterprise search systems often suffer from high token usage, slow retrieval latencies, and complex external vector database dependencies (e.g. Pinecone) that complicate deployment pipelines. Narration: To address this, I built a local, file-based Graph RAG engine that works entirely inside Git. It pre-compiles and serializes the document knowledge graph and MiniSearch trie indexes during the Next.js build phase. At runtime, the data is eagerly deserialized and queries are cached in a warm Map in serverless nodes, serving grounded results in sub-millisecond ranges.

facts: Status: PRODUCTION in environment Git-controlled static JSON + in-memory MiniSearch
Public Surface: Next.js /api/retrieve (Exposes retrieved context payload structure.)
Trie Search: MiniSearch (Pre-compiled static trie loads at boot time.)
Retrieval Speed: < 0.5ms (Served directly from warm container RAM.)
Zone Static Build Phase: Crawler extracts nodes/edges and serializes the search trie index.
Zone Serverless Node Memory: Eager MiniSearch & Graphology instantiations with warm query cache map.
Zone Astra Chat UI: Retrieves context via gatherResearchMarkdown to ground LLM completions.
Component Manifest Index: data/manifest.json static ledger (Stores pre-compiled entity nodes, relationship links, and word weights.)
Component MiniSearch trie: Eager index deserializer (Loads the serialized search index trie at module import time, bypassing runtime compilation.)
Component Graph topology: Eager undirected graphology instance (Instantiated at spin-up to traverse documentation relationships with zero cold-start lags.)
Component FIFO Cache: Warm Map memory cache (Caches up to 100 queries in container memory to serve duplicate questions in 0.1ms.)
Component Grounded prompt: Token-compressed context prompt (Combines compressed graph traversal content to reduce prompt tokens by 85%.)
